source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: nsImapMailFolder.h uses nsIMsgThread pointers in declarations and forward-declares the interface. The cpp includes nsIMsgThread.h where its full interface is needed. Review explicitly questions and then accepts this file-role distinction. This is scoped C++ dependency guidance, not a mandate to forward-declare every type or proof of faster compilation. No transitive-include/build measurement ran.
title: The IMAP header forward-declares a pointer-only thread interface
